chunks: As for what al-Husayn ibn Sa'id narrated from Safwan ibn Yahya and Fadalah, from al-'Ala' ibn Razin, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two of them عليهما السلام, who said:
It is not appropriate for the Imam to perform the Zuhr salat on the Day of Tarwiyah except at Mina, and he should remain there through the night until sunrise.

key_terms.الظُّهْرَ: the Zuhr salat, the noon prayer
key_terms.الْإِمَامِ: the Imam, here referring to the prayer leader or divinely designated leader in the ritual context
key_terms.بِمِنًى: at Mina, the sacred location where pilgrims stay during hajj
key_terms.طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ: sunrise, the time limit mentioned for remaining in Mina
key_terms.يَوْمَ التَّرْوِيَةِ: the Day of Tarwiyah, the eighth day of Dhu al-Hijjah in the hajj rites

ai.seo_question: When should the Imam go out to Mina on the Day of Tarwiyah during hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning the Imam's movement to Mina during hajj on the Day of Tarwiyah. It indicates that the Zuhr salat should be performed at Mina and that the night should be spent there until sunrise.
